sources.title: h2o-lightning-4b by H2O.ai: Open-Weight Model - savrn.com
sources.snippet: h2o-lightning-4b is an open-weight model for image and text to text from H2O.ai, released under Apache License 2.0. It has 4.5B parameters and a 262,144-token context. At 16-bit it needs about 10.9 GB of GPU memory, which fits on 1x MI300X from $1.85 an hour, at the lowest prices in the SAVRN Index. It draws 135 downloads a month.
